title: Five-Bull Sight-In
desc: General sight-in. Five 2.5 in. bulls on a 1 in. grid. Pistol 7-15 yd, rifle 25-50 yd.
drills: Fire a 3-shot group on bull 1, adjust, then confirm with 3 shots each on bulls 2 and 3.
One shot per bull in order 1-5, twice. Every hit must stay in the orange.
Make your first shot of every session on bull 1 and write down where it lands versus your zero.

title: 100-Yard Zero Grid
desc: 1 in. squares. At 100 yd each square is about 1 MOA (1.047 in.). Center diamond for zero, corners for confirmation.
drills: Fire 3 at the center diamond, count squares to center (1 square = 1 MOA), dial, then confirm with 3 more.
One shot on each corner diamond. All four inside the diamonds means your zero holds.
Shoot center, dial 4 MOA up and shoot, 4 right, 4 down, 4 left. Hits should form a square and end on the first hole. Tests turret tracking.

title: 25 m Metric Zero
desc: 1 cm squares. At 25 m each square = 0.4 mil (about 1.4 MOA). Move impacts to the center circle.
drills: Adjust until the group centers in the 4 cm circle. Each square is 0.4 mil.
Fire 3, dial exactly 1 mil up, fire 3. The second group should land 2.5 cm higher, two and a half squares.
Five each prone, kneeling and standing. Measure each group in cm and log the spread.

title: MOA Dot Ladder
desc: Dot sizes in true MOA at 100 yd. Rows: 2, 1.5, 1 and 0.5 MOA. Shoot each row smaller as you tighten up.
drills: One shot per dot, working from the 2 MOA row down. The row where you start missing is your real precision today.
2 MOA row prone, 1.5 MOA sitting, 1 MOA kneeling off a bag, 0.5 MOA prone off a bag.
On the beep, build position and fire one shot on a 1 MOA dot within 10 seconds. Repeat on each 1 MOA dot.

title: Precision Bullseye
desc: Slow-fire scoring target. Rings 10 to 5 plus X ring. Score each shot by the highest ring it touches.
drills: Ten shots, one hand or two. Score each ring and total out of 100.
Two strings of 5 rounds in 20 seconds each.
Two strings of 5 rounds in 10 seconds each. Compare with your slow-fire score.

title: Rimfire 12-Bull
desc: Ten 1.5 in. record bulls plus two sighters. Built for 50 ft / 25 yd rimfire and air rifle practice.
drills: Two shots on the sighters, then one shot per record bull. Score out of 100.
You get only two sighters, then you commit. No re-shooting a record bull.

title: Ten-Dot Drill
desc: 2 in. and 1 in. dots. Run each numbered string in order. Any miss on a string means you rerun it.
drills: Shoot the strings printed on the sheet. Score one point for every string with no misses, out of 10.
Move back 2 yd only after you run all 10 strings clean.
Run strings 2 and 4 with a 2.0 s par per draw. Misses or over time count as a fail.

title: Reduced Silhouette
desc: Generic torso and head with scoring zones. Reduced size: shooting it at 10 yd looks like a full-size target at about 30 yd.
drills: From the holster, six rounds into the A zone as fast as you can keep them there.
Two to the body A zone, then one to the head A zone.
Two to the body, emergency reload, two more to the body.

title: Shapes & Numbers
desc: Call-out drill. A partner calls a shape, a color, or a number and you engage only that target. Builds target ID under time.
drills: A partner calls a color, shape or number. Engage every target that matches, one round each.
A partner calls an equation like 9 minus 4. Shoot the answer.
A partner calls three numbers. Shoot them in that order.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
desc: Two shooters, one target. Hit a square to claim it with your color of marker. First to three in a row wins.
drills: Take turns firing one round to claim a square. A miss loses your turn.
Both shooters go on the beep. First to three in a row wins.
Shoot any row, column or diagonal, one round per square. Then all three rows back to back.

title: Plate Rack
desc: Two racks of six 1 in. plates plus a stop plate. At 10 yd each plate matches a 4 in. steel plate at 40 yd.
drills: Top rack left to right, then the stop plate. Repeat on the bottom rack.
Odd plates left to right, then even plates right to left, then stop.
Three plates, reload, three plates, stop plate.

title: Error Diagnosis
desc: For a right-handed handgun shooter (mirror it if left-handed). Fire 10 slow shots at the center, then read where they cluster.
drills: Ten slow shots at the center. Read the cluster against the chart and pick one fix to work on.
A partner loads your magazine with a snap cap at random. Watch the muzzle when the dummy round clicks: any dip is a flinch.
Unloaded and verified. Press the trigger 20 times against a blank wall without the front sight moving.

title: Load Development
desc: Ten 1 in. diamonds for a ladder or OCW test. Write the charge and seating depth under each.
drills: One shot per charge, in order, all at the same aim point. Look for loads whose impacts cluster vertically.
Fire one round of each load in rotation until each diamond has three. This spreads barrel heat evenly.
Pick your best charge and vary only the seating depth across the diamonds.

title: Transitions
desc: Three head boxes spread wide. Draw, one shot each left to right, then right to left. Push speed, keep hits in the box.
drills: Two rounds on each top box, reload, two more on each.
Two rounds each on the bottom row, 4-5-6.

title: Half-Inch Grid
desc: Blank 1/2 in. grid with a center cross. Use it for anything: group measuring, custom drills, or a backer.
drills: Mark your own aim points with a marker or paster before shooting.
One shot on each intersection along the center line, moving out one square each shot.
Shoot a group, then use the half-inch lines to measure it without a ruler.

title: Range Log
desc: Record each group. Measure center-to-center (largest spread minus one bullet diameter).

title: Pocket DOPE Cards
desc: Four 3.5 x 4.25 in. cards. Cut on the dashed lines, fill in your come-ups, and tape one to the stock or keep it in a sleeve.

title: Full DOPE Sheet
desc: One rifle, 50 yd steps out to 1000. Record conditions at the top so you know what the data was shot in.

title: Angular Reference
desc: How big a MOA, a mil and one click are at each distance, plus range-estimation and conversion formulas.

title: Wind Card
desc: Wind value by clock direction, field cues for estimating speed, and a blank hold table for your load.

title: Round Count Log
desc: Track rounds, cleaning, parts and malfunctions for one firearm. Helps you replace springs and barrels on schedule.

title: Range Day Checklist
desc: Run through this before you leave the house. Laminate it and check boxes with a dry-erase marker.

title: 36-Yard Zero
desc: Grid squares are 1 MOA at 36 yd (0.377 in.). A common carbine zero distance. Confirm at your far distance afterward.
drills: Adjust until groups center on the dot. Each square is 1 MOA at this distance.
Confirm the zero at the far distance your optic and ammo call for, and log any change.
Fire a 5-round group and count squares to read it in MOA directly.

title: Data Book Page
desc: One page per string. Plot where you called each shot and where it hit. The gap between the two shows what to fix.
drills: Before you look, plot your call on the left. Then plot the hit on the right.
Count how many hits landed within one ring of your call. Above 8 of 10 means you can trust your calls.
Write one correction at the bottom, shoot the next string, and see if it closed the gap.

title: Metric DOPE Cards
desc: Four cut-out cards ranged in meters (100-1000 m) for mil-based optics. Same layout as the yard cards.

title: Range Card
desc: Sketch your sector from your position: left and right limits, reference points and their ranges. Fill in the table to match.
drills: Build a range card before you shoot anything: limits first, then reference points with ranges.
Estimate each reference point first, then laser it. Log the difference.
On the call, find it with the card and give your hold within 10 seconds.

title: Range Estimation
desc: Mil-relation table in meters. Measure the target in mils through your reticle, find its row, and read the range.
drills: Measure an object in mils, work the range from the table, then laser it.
Estimate a distance by eye, pace or laser it, and keep a running error log.
Range each target with the table only, then engage it. Score first-round hits.

title: Fundamentals Card
desc: Safety rules, the marksmanship fundamentals, position checkpoints and immediate action for a stoppage. Laminate for the range bag.

title: Dry-Fire Log
desc: Daily dry practice tracker. Unload, move all ammo out of the room, verify empty, and pick a safe backstop before every session.

title: FBI Q-Style
desc: Bottle-shaped 'Q' target used in law enforcement qualification. Any hit inside the bottle counts.
drills: From the holster, three hits inside the bottle.
Two rounds inside the narrow neck of the bottle. Builds precision under time.
Three rounds at each distance, all inside the bottle, par 3.0 s each.

title: FBI QIT-Style
desc: Q bottle with the lower part cut off by a dashed line. Only hits inside the bottle and above the line count.
drills: Shoot the full course on card T-32 and score it. 48 of 60 passes.
Run the 3, 5 and 7 yd stages only. Track your hit percentage.
Any hit below the dashed line counts as a miss. Shoot 10 and keep all above it.

title: FBI Pistol Qual Card
desc: The publicly reported FBI pistol qualification: 60 rounds on a QIT-style target, 48 hits to pass. Score each stage below.

title: Police Silhouette
desc: B-27-style law enforcement silhouette with scoring rings 7 to 10 around center mass. Training replica.
drills: All ten in the 8 ring or better. Score the rings for a total.
Draw and fire 1 round, holster. Then draw to 2, 3, 4 and 5. All inside the 9 ring.
Four rounds at each distance from the holster, par 4 s each.

title: Military E-Type
desc: Standard military head-and-torso silhouette (about 19.5 x 40 in. full size). Any hit on the silhouette counts.
drills: Ten rounds on the silhouette. Any hit counts.
Two rounds standing, drop to kneeling for two, then prone for two.
At 60 m this sheet looks like a full E-type at 300 m. Hold center and count hits.

title: Military F-Type
desc: Head-and-shoulders silhouette (about 19.5 x 23 in. full size), representing a target behind cover.
drills: Three rounds from the left side of a barricade, then three from the right.
At 30 m this sheet appears like a full F-type at 100 m. Five hits from kneeling.
From low ready, one round on the silhouette within 3 seconds, five times.

title: Scaled Distance Silhouettes
desc: E- and F-type silhouettes shrunk to simulate 100-300 m when shot from 10 m. Build distance skills on a short range.
drills: Engage 100 to 300 m in order, one round each. Then repeat from kneeling.
A partner calls a distance. Find it and fire one round within 4 seconds.
Two hits on every silhouette from prone.

title: Practical Competition
desc: USPSA/IPSC-style action shooting target with A, C and D zones and head box. Training replica.
drills: Two draws to 3 rounds. Score points (A=5, C=3, D=1) divided by time.
Three draws to two rounds in the body A zone.
One round in the head A zone from the holster, five repetitions.

title: Drill Book 1
desc: Three drills each for T-01 to T-05. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.

title: Drill Book 2
desc: Three drills each for T-06 to T-10. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.

title: Drill Book 3
desc: Three drills each for T-11 to T-15. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.

title: Drill Book 4
desc: Three drills each for T-23 to T-27. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.

title: Drill Book 5
desc: Three drills each for T-30 to T-34. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.

title: Drill Book 6
desc: Three drills each for T-35 to T-37. Tick the box once you run a drill clean.
